g.text: MCU ↔ SPI flash · fixed top-layer bus
Rectangles = breakout regions · circles = component pads · labeled points = solver-selected boundary gates
Dashed paths are straight-line routing guides, not generated copper traces
Each color follows one connection through its boundary gates
Gray = geometry shared by multiple layers

text.data-label: Valid: one bus-constrained breakout point per connection and region; pairs are adjacent
